bole.text: A cone of roots shows at the stem base: roots bright red when young, up to 1 m long (cone height not given; 1 m is the root length). Spanish/Portuguese Wikipedia: roots about 30 cm, compact and scaly, with mucilaginous tips. Crownshaft present: sheaths 0.5-1.6 m, green, striped lighter green, or yellow; var. precatoria green with yellow vertical stripes (da Rocha et al. 2025).

crown.text: 5-10(-20) leaves, spreading and somewhat arched, with pendulous pinnae. 'medium' density is inferred from the leaf count, not stated.

leaf.shape: pinnae 43-91 per side, narrow and linear, weakly to strongly pendulous (sometimes horizontal); middle pinnae 60-88 x 1-3 cm, basal 46-70 x 0.2-1 cm, apical 18-44 x 0.5-2 cm

phenology.fruit: globose drupe, 0.9-1.3 cm, purple-black epicarp, thin pulp; more than 1,000 fruits per bunch. Inflorescence below the crownshaft, horizontal at anthesis, about 200 rachillae.

bark.text: Stem slender, smooth and grey with ring-shaped leaf scars, about 11 cm apart in vigorous palms (da Rocha et al. 2025); 'brownish to grey' is from Portuguese Wikipedia.

palm.text: Henderson & Galeano: crownshaft sheaths 0.5-1.6 m, green (striped lighter green or yellow); petiole (0-)12-57 cm; pinnae 43-91 per side, narrow, linear, weakly to strongly pendulous, the middle ones 60-88 x 1-3 cm; leaves spreading and somewhat arched; a cone of roots at the stem base, bright red when young, up to 1 m (count and thickness not given). da Rocha et al. 2025 (src 4): adults about 16 cm in diameter at breast height (stem_diameter_cm.base), ring-shaped leaf scars about 11 cm apart in vigorous palms.

habitat.range: var. precatoria: Colombia, Venezuela, Trinidad, the Guianas, Ecuador, Peru, Brazil, Bolivia; var. longevaginata in Central America and Colombia

notes: Height and diameter are the species range (Henderson & Galeano 1996); adults reach about 20 m and 16 cm at breast height (da Rocha et al. 2025). Leaves: 5-10(-20) in the monograph; 10-15 in Spanish/Portuguese Wikipedia; about 14 in adults (da Rocha). leaf.length_cm is the rachis (1.6-3.6 m); the petiole adds (0-)12-57 cm. Habitat: var. precatoria lowland rain forest, commonly along rivers in periodically inundated areas, below 350 m (occasionally to 600 m). da Rocha lists terra firme, swampy blackwater lowlands (baixios) and high varzea. UTP says 'swampy ground'. Phenology: no Madre de Dios data. fruiting_months are from the upper Acre River (Epitaciolandia, Acre, Brazil, next to Madre de Dios): baixio Mar-Jun, terra firme Jun-Oct. Elsewhere in Acre: Chico Mendes reserve Mar-Sep; Tarauaca baixio Jan-Apr, terra firme Jul-Sep. Inflorescences emerge mainly Aug-Dec at Manaus (central Amazon), so flowering_months are left empty. Flower colour not found. Eaten_by: da Rocha says the fruits feed birds, fruit bats and rodents but names no species; no species-level frugivore source found (toucan/guan studies found were on Euterpe edulis). Evergreen is assumed for a palm, not stated.
